coverage.note: Expanded retrospective reconstruction from 42 human-reviewed public pages, selected from 272 dated 30D candidates discovered across 37 working public feeds and sitemaps. It is still a research baseline, not yet a continuously observed market series. The 90D comparison remains withheld because 180 days of observed corpus are required.

narratives.title: Agent 的价值从回答问题转向交付可验证工作
narratives.english: Agents deliver verifiable work, not just answers
narratives.one_sentence_claim: 主流语言正从“模型能不能回答”转向“Agent 能否完成任务、写回系统、让人检查结果”。
narratives.why_read_now: 这决定了 AI application 的产品边界、价值单位和可以向企业承担的责任。
narratives.weekly_take: 扩展后的 30D 回溯样本中，当前窗有九个合格信号、六个独立 actor，前窗为三个信号、三个 actor；样本支持“升温”，但它仍是回溯基线，不代表连续观测已经建立。

buying: 拥有具体 workflow、上下文和可验收交付的 Agent
能够进入客户真实系统的垂直 AI employee / operator
skeptical: 只在 chat UI 中显示模型能力，没有产出物、责任边界或写回闭环
把 long-horizon 直接等同于可靠自治，忽略轨迹级风险和回滚能力

90d.coverage_note: Insufficient retrospective_corpus for two 90D windows: corpus_started_too_late.

sources.title: AI Ascent 2026

sources.why_included: 代表性 VC 对 agents + harnesses 的公开 framing。

sources.title: Investing in Exa

sources.title: Expanded technical preview availability for the GitHub Copilot app
sources.statement: GitHub describes the human role around agents as managing output and inspecting consequential changes, not merely prompting for answers.

sources.title: Canary Technologies launches Agentic Sales Coordinator

sources.statement: Oracle embedded AI into OPERA Cloud's existing hotel operating workflows instead of requiring a separate AI system.
sources.why_included: 成熟 PMS 厂商将 AI 直接嵌入现有操作流。

sources.title: How agents are transforming work
sources.statement: OpenAI describes agentic AI as changing the unit of knowledge work from an interaction to a delegated task that can run across tools and time.
sources.why_included: 平台方用 delegated long-horizon tasks 定义新的工作单位。

sources.title: Building Trust – How Agentic AI Earns Its Place in Hospitality
sources.statement: Mews argues that hospitality agents earn trust through native system context, evaluations and guarded action rather than an AI layer detached from the system of record.
sources.why_included: 垂直行业对可信任 Agent 提出 system-of-record 与 guardrails 条件。

sources.title: Introducing Branch: One Context, Many Parallel Directions
sources.statement: Manus shipped parallel agent sessions that reuse accumulated context while isolating work streams.

sources.statement: OpenAI launched Presence as a production agent system built around specific jobs, approved actions, policies, evaluations, escalation and post-launch improvement.
sources.why_included: 生产级 Agent 被明确拆成任务、权限、评估、升级与持续改进。

narratives.title: Enterprise AI 的瓶颈从模型访问转向部署与运营
narratives.english: Enterprise AI moves from model access to deployment operations
narratives.one_sentence_claim: FDE、partner network、governance、integration 和 change management 正在从服务附件变成 Enterprise AI 产品的核心交付层。
narratives.why_read_now: 大客户不是缺一个更聪明的 Demo，而是缺把 AI 安全地放进数据、权限、流程和组织中的交付机制。
narratives.weekly_take: 扩展后的 30D 回溯样本中，当前窗有九个合格信号、八个独立 actor，高于前窗的四个信号、四个 actor；部署与运营层的公开动作明显增多，但仍需连续采集确认斜率。

buying: 能把模型落到 mission-critical workflow 的交付能力
可重复的行业模板、评估、权限和部署方法
skeptical: 试点数量很多但生产部署和客户背书很少
用大量定制项目掩盖产品无法标准化

narratives.title: AI pricing 正从 seat-only 分化为 usage、outcome 与预算控制
narratives.english: AI pricing becomes hybrid, usage-aware and governed
narratives.one_sentence_claim: 企业 AI 并没有收敛到单一计价模式，而是出现 seat + included credits + overage、token usage 和 pay-per-outcome 的多种组合。
narratives.why_read_now: 当 AI 从偶尔问答变成持续工作，价格、用量可见性、预算责任和交付结果必须一起被设计。
narratives.weekly_take: 扩展后的 30D 回溯样本中，当前窗有八个合格信号、四个独立 actor，高于前窗的两个信号、两个 actor；可判为升温，但它代表计价与价值衡量实验增多，不是已经形成唯一答案。

buying: 价格单位与客户可见的工作量或结果挂钩
有用量可见性、预算上限和毛利管理的 hybrid model
skeptical: 只把 token 换成新名词，客户看不到消耗与业务价值的关系
纯 outcome pricing 却无法界定责任、基准和可控成本
